text: Databases store and organize information so we can find it quickly. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, while NoSQL databases store data in flexible formats like documents. To get information from a database, we write queries, which are special commands that ask for specific data. Before building a database, developers do data modeling to plan how information connects. They also create indexes, which work like a book's index and help the database find data much faster. Choosing the right type and design makes applications work better.
